claims.evidence: Photo 2 shows an 'EPAL' stamp suggesting a European standard pallet, but photos 0/1 show a different, less legible stamped stack and photo 3 shows an unmarked new-looking frame — origin is inconsistent across the lot.

claims.claim: Everything is clean, dry and sorted, no water added
claims.evidence: Photos 0, 1 and 3 show pallets sitting on dirt/debris-strewn ground with junk scattered around, not a sorted clean yard; wood moisture itself cannot be assessed from any photo.

claims.claim: Weighed at 500 kg on a certified scale this morning
claims.evidence: No scale, receipt, or weighing scene appears in any photo.

risks.risk: Lot may be a mixed batch of different pallet grades (two visibly different stacks shown)
risks.proof: A single wide shot showing all pallets being sold together with a count of each type/condition
risks.if_unproven: priced as the lower-grade, dirtier stack (photos 0/1)

risks.risk: EPAL stamp may not be genuine or consistent across all units
risks.proof: Close-up, well-lit photo of the stamp on several pallets, not just one

risks.risk: Wood condition (rot, insect damage, moisture) cannot be judged from current distance shots
risks.proof: Close-up photos/video of wood grain, corners, and undersides of several pallets
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified condition, assume moderate wear

risks.risk: Nails/fasteners may be rusted, loose, or protruding
risks.proof: Close-up photo of joints and nail heads

risks.risk: No proof of heat-treatment (HT) marking required for export-grade pallets
risks.proof: Clear photo of the stamp showing 'HT' or treatment code
Video or photo of pallets on a scale with reading visible, plus a count
risks.if_unproven: priced at the lower bound quantity visible in photos

proof_requests: Wide shot of the entire lot being sold together with a visible count
Close-up, well-lit photos of the EPAL/HT stamps on multiple pallets
Close-up photos of wood surfaces, corners, and nail joints
Video or photo of the pallets being weighed on a scale with the reading visible
response.reason: The witness confirms the item is wooden pallets, so it can be priced at worst case given unverified quality, mixed stacks, and unproven weight/treatment claims.
